TITLE: Crux — The "First Wrong Step" Self-Check That Withholds the Answer
CLAIM: A problem-set companion where you photograph YOUR worked solution and it tells you only the line where your reasoning first diverges — never the answer, never the next step — then asks you a targeted retrieval question to get you unstuck, owning the 11pm "is my work right?" moment without becoming an answer machine.
RATIONALE: The most-described study workflow in search results is "find the first step where your process diverges" — yet every existing tool is built answer-first (Photomath, Mathos, AskSia, HomeworkO all solve the problem and SHOW the solution), which is exactly the answer-dependence the cognitive-offloading literature flags. The white space is a deliberately answer-WITHHOLDING checker engineered for desirable difficulty: localize the error, force the fix.
STUDENT MOMENT: The late-night "I finished the problem but I'm not sure it's right, and I don't want to just copy Photomath" moment.
COMPETITORS: (a) ChatGPT/Gemini Study Mode: Socratic nudging but re-derives from the PROBLEM and readily leaks the full solution if pushed ("can be bypassed by determined students"); doesn't reliably read YOUR handwritten work and pinpoint YOUR first divergent line. (b) MathZAI Smart Solution Check and AskSia verify steps but present the corrected full solution; none refuses the answer by design. (c) Funded: Photomath/Mathpresso/QANDA are answer-delivery — the opposite posture. (d) Research: MathPad's Step Checker "flags the exact line without revealing the answer" as a Google-Workspace feature — validates demand, not a standalone B2C habit product. Open: answer-withholding, error-localizing, retrieval-prompting as the WHOLE experience.
CHATGPT-PROOF: A content/posture moat plus device capture: robustly reading handwritten work and a hard product guarantee it will NEVER emit the solution. Chat's incentive and UX is maximal helpfulness (leaks the answer); Crux's brand promise — credible to professors — is that it structurally cannot. Replicating in raw chat means fighting the model's helpfulness every turn.
CORE AI: Vision OCR of handwritten multi-step work + a symbolic verifier (CAS) independently checking each transition for validity, returning the index of the first invalid step. An LLM generates a single targeted retrieval prompt at that step ("what rule governs differentiating a product here?") — never the substitution. Robust-coarse: if a step is illegible, ask, don't guess.
INTEGRITY+TRUST: The strongest integrity posture in the set: designed FOR the generation effect and retrieval practice and AGAINST answer-copying. A professor reads "tells students where they went wrong but makes them fix it" and approves — the anti-Chegg.
